defs.def: a strong border or structure of wood, metal, etc. that holds a picture, door, piece of glass, etc. in position （图画、门、玻璃等的）框架

ex.s: This indicates that Goffin’s cockatoos do indeed possess an allocentric frame of reference when moving objects in space, similar to two-year-old babies.
ex.t: 这表明戈芬氏凤头鹦鹉在空间中移动物体时确实拥有客体参照框架，类似于两岁婴儿。

ex.s: A fixed frame will make time meaningless．
ex.t: 固定的框架会让时间失去意义。

ex.s: Modern technology may help to shape the rivers’ temporal frame．
ex.t: 现代技术可能有助于塑造河流的时间框架．

ex.s: At length the last struggle came, in which the strong frame of the old man slowly yielded to destruction.
ex.t: 最后的挣扎终于来了，老人强壮的身躯慢慢地屈服于毁灭。

ex.s: Prepare Draw or write your cartoon strip frames and practise your play.
ex.t: 准备：画出或写出你漫画的框架，并练习你的表演。

defs.def: the supporting structure of a piece of furniture, a building, a vehicle, etc. that gives it its shape （家具、建筑物、车辆等的）构架，支架，骨架

ex.s: This ability to recognize that a shape will need to be turned in a specific direction before it will fit is called an “allocentric frame of reference”.
ex.t: 这种识别形状需要朝特定方向旋转才能放入的能力被称为"异中心参照系"。

defs.def: a structure of plastic or metal that holds the lenses in a pair of glasses 眼镜框
the form or structure of a person or animal's body 体形；身材；骨架
the general ideas or structure that form the background to sth （构成某事物背景的）总的思想，体系，体制，模式
one of the single photographs that a film or video is made of 镜头；画面
a single picture in a comic strip （连环漫画中的）一幅画
one of the separate areas on an Internet page that you can scroll through (= read by using the mouse to move the text up or down) 帧；页帧（框）；图文框

ex.s: Nature seems to unfold to people who watch and wait． Next time you take a walk， no matter where it is， take in all the sights， sounds and sensations． Wander in this frame of mind and you will open a new dimension to your life．
ex.t: 大自然似乎向那些观察和等待的人展开。下次你散步时，无论在哪里，都要领略所有的景色、声音和感觉。带着这种心态闲逛，你会为生活打开一个新的维度。

ex.s: He still felt uncomfortably cold, even under a heavy 3 The house was old with 4 and a look of somewhere that had not been taken care of for many years.The 5 in the bedroom swayed in the wind that blew through the old window frame.
ex.t: 即使在厚厚的棉被下，他仍然感到不舒服地冷。房子很旧，窗框在吹过的风中摇晃，看起来是好久没人照料的样子。

ex.s: In the past few weeks, an increasing sense of 3 depressed / variantwaveshadnearlydestroyedtheship.Theythoughttheywould5sink/capturebut thankfully, the 6 solid / sawed wooden frame and sails had held together.
ex.t: 在过去的几周里，一种越来越强烈的3种压抑/变形波影几乎摧毁了飞船。 他们认为他们将会沉没/捕获，但幸好，这6种固态/锯木框和帆合在一起。

defs.def: a single section of play in the game of snooker, etc., or in bowling 一轮；一回；一局
to put or make a frame or border around sth 给 … 做框；给 … 镶边

ex.s: To make some of my landscape shots, I have traveled up to four hours away to shoot within a 10-minute time frame.
ex.t: 为了拍摄我的一些风景照，我曾驱车长达四小时，只为在十分钟的时间窗口内拍摄。

defs.def: to produce false evidence against an innocent person so that people think he or she is guilty 作伪证陷害
to create and develop sth such as a plan, a system or a set of rules 制订；拟订

ex.s: To frame his story, Klein creates the character of Ned, a fictional witness to the progress brought about by the steams and electric revolutions in America during one man's lifetime.
ex.t: 为了构建他的故事，Klein创造了Ned这个角色，一个见证美国在一个人的有生之年因蒸汽和电力革命而取得进展的虚构人物。

defs.def: to express sth in a particular way （以某种方式）表达

ex.s: Learning to learn A polite interruption is usually framed as a request for permission to interrupt someone, often starting with If…, May I…?
ex.t: 学会学习 礼貌的打断通常是以请求允许打断别人的方式来表达的，常常以If…, May I…开头？
